bibl.title: Garlic Braids Sent by a Physician in BGU 7.1674
bibl.seg: Nikos Litinas, Garlic Braids Sent by a Physician in BGU 7.1674.
bibl.note: In BGU 7.1674, a revision yields an attestation of the word σειρά (for garlic braids). Although it is an addendum lexicis with this specific meaning, it is understandable and fits the context. The sender, who is a physician, has arranged for some items that possibly concern medicine (that is, garlic) and certainly concern astrology (that is, an astrological table) to be sent to the recipient.
